title: Graph Theoretic Framework of Dynamical Systems Through the Boundary Polynomial
summary: This work is devoted to the study of the relationships between graph theory and the qualitative analysis of ordinary differential equations, with a special focus on two-dimensional systems. In particular, we reinterpret classical results through the lens of boundary polynomials of graphs. The theory naturally leads to questions about limit cycles, which arise in many processes in nature and remain a central object of study in dynamical systems.
